elements.name: rectangle-two-point-01 Create a rectangle from opposite corners

steps.name: the MCAD Software is running
an editable planar sketch
the user select Two Point Rectangle and click diagonally opposite corners
four connected sides form an axis-aligned closed rectangle
the user press Escape
the rectangle remains and the sketch is Ready

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-06 Cancel before the opposite corner

steps.name: an editable sketch is Ready
the user choose Rectangle Two Point and click the fixture first corner
the prompt requests the opposite corner
the user press Escape
the MCAD Software returns to Ready without a new rectangle

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-07 Keep selecting after identical corner clicks

steps.name: an editable sketch is Ready
the user invoke Two Point Rectangle
the user click the same fixture position for both corners
Select opposite corner remains active
both dynamic size fields display 0,000 mm
no error dialog or rectangle appears
the user press Escape
the MCAD Software returns to Ready

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-08 Commit typed sizes and restore through history

steps.name: an editable sketch in RIGHT view with the required fixture
the user start Two Point Rectangle and select a first corner
the user press 1 and then 0
the user press Tab
the user press 6 and then Enter
a rectangle with size annotations 10 and 6 is committed
the command returns to Select first corner
the user press Escape and then Ctrl+Z
the rectangle and its two size annotations disappear
the user press Ctrl+Y
the rectangle and both annotations return

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-09 Verify the numeric rectangle edge lengths

steps.name: the recorded numeric rectangle in RIGHT view has been restored
the user open Measure and select its vertical edge away from endpoints
Selection 1 is a Curve with Length 10.000 mm
the user click empty canvas and select its horizontal edge away from endpoints
Selection 1 is a Curve with Length 6.000 mm
the user click Done
Measure closes and the rectangle remains

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-10 Observe a zero first size

steps.name: the recorded fixture sketch is Ready with 22 dimensions needed
the user choose Two Point Rectangle and the fixture first corner
the user enter 0 and press Tab
the first size is locked at 0.000 mm and the second field is focused
the user enter 4 and press Return
the command returns to Select first corner without a warning dialog
the immediate status temporarily shows 24 dimensions needed

steps.name: a fresh Two Point Rectangle command in the recorded sketch view
the existing ellipse from the recorded fixture is visible
the user select the fixture first corner, enter 6, press Tab, enter 4 and press Return
the rectangle shows height 6 and width 4
the rectangle extends upward and rightward in the recorded view
it overlaps part of the existing ellipse
the user press Escape
the rectangle remains and Ready returns

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-12 Cancel a rectangle height proposal

steps.name: the rectangle height editor is open with 6 mm selected
the user enter 8 and press Escape
the user reopen the height annotation
the height editor still contains 6 mm

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-13 Accept and undo a rectangle height edit

steps.name: the recorded Right-view sketch contains the overlapping ellipse and a rectangle annotated 6 mm high by 4 mm wide, with its height edit active
the user accepts height 8 mm and exits General Dimension
the height annotation shows 8 and the width annotation remains 4
the user opens Measure and selects the left edge
Measure reports the selected left edge length as 8.000 mm
the user closes Measure and undoes the height edit
the visible height annotation returns to 6
the user redoes the height edit
the visible height annotation returns to 8
width annotation 4 remains

elements.name: rectangle-two-point-14 Observe a zero second size

steps.name: the recorded sketch is Ready with the 4-by-8 rectangle retained
the user start Two Point Rectangle and click the fixture first corner
the user enter 4, press Tab, enter 0 and press Return
Select first corner returns without a warning or a visible new rectangle
the user press Escape
Ready returns and the prior rectangle remains
